AssemblyLimits.description: Per-case bounds, distinct from a local derivative artifact's resource budget.

contributions.description: Maximum original derivative contributions before duplicate accumulation.

native_index.description: Largest dimension/index/entry count representable by the selected native ABI.

worker_bytes.description: Complete attempt storage budget: shared evaluator scratch, clones and occurrence caches.

EvaluationLimits.description: Explicit resource allowance for one compiled body and its worker.

operations.description: Maximum scalar arithmetic operations per compiled demand.

provider_calls.description: Maximum provider calls in the admitted control schedule.

scratch_bytes.description: Maximum owned numeric scratch bytes per worker.

Evaluator.description:
Explicit evaluator implementation. Scalar C++ compilation is opt-in for eligible
demanded arithmetic products; provider calls and ordered guards remain host-owned.

oneOf.description:
Fixed conservative Linux x86-64 C++ profile. The finite allowance covers
each module's export temporaries, named compiler outputs, loaded code,
template metadata and bounded diagnostic reader; worker numeric scratch
remains independently charged from the exported stack.

module_bytes.description: Prepaid complete native preparation/module capacity for each arithmetic block.

body_occurrences.description:
Optional operation/occurrence allowance for each lowered mathematical body.
None uses the mathematical backend's default, independently of mesh extent.

body_slots.description:
Optional formal-slot allowance (inputs plus stage results) for each lowered
mathematical body; the process-global formal pool extends up to it, and a body
needing more is refused with its required and available slots. None uses the
mathematical backend's default, the initially registered pool chunk.

items.description: Maximum instances, indexed members and generated equations.

members.description: Maximum members of one derived finite set/product.

Optimization.description: Explicit optimizer controls; no target-dependent or unbounded defaults.

evaluator.description: Explicit implementation for scalar Value arithmetic blocks.

Profile.description: Consumed compilation controls, separate from semantic preparation.

assembly.description: Per-case sparse assembly and complete numerical-worker admission limits.

class_proof_work.description:
Shared finite conservative construction work for domain facts and demanded
class proof, including expression storage/substitution bounds and derivative
calls. These units are not measured library-operation counters and do not
admit byte allocations or numerical evaluator work.

evaluation.description: Local numeric limits affecting evaluator admission.

description: Serialization of the existing compiler/expansion controls, with no second defaults.

compiler.description: Existing evaluator profile, encoded by its actual source declaration.

title: PreparationSettings
